name: consent_script
label: My name is __. I work with Kabarak University and its partner institutions on a research study titled "Quantifying the Hidden Health Costs of Climate Change for Equitable Health System Adaptation in Eastern and Southern Africa". The study is being carried out in selected counties of Kenya and districts of Malawi. It aims to identify health problems caused or made worse by droughts, floods and extreme heat, to measure the costs these events impose on households and the health system, and to assess how well health services are prepared to respond. With your permission, I will ask about services, staffing, supplies, infrastructure and spending, observe selected areas, and copy summary figures from registers and DHIS2. No patient names or personal details will be collected. This will take about 60 to 90 minutes. Taking part is voluntary; you may decline any question or stop at any time without consequence. Your name will not appear in any report and there are no known risks apart from the time taken. For questions about the study, contact Dr. Michael Walekhwa, Dr. Harrison Mbori or Dr. Idah Githu on: +254-705-290520, +254-729-035308 and +254-703-702711. For questions about your rights as a participant, contact Ms. Sarah Malinda on +254-715 -634073 or Ms. Caroline Jebichii on +254-720-057542. The study has been approved by Kabarak University ISERC – 051-343234 and licensed by NACOSTI/P/26/4198513 for Kenya, and NHSRC, for Malawi]. Do you agree to take part?
